scope: PR #175 PR-A (22 files): the edit-time select/load gate - edit-gate.mjs (PreToolUse), check-task-plan.mjs (selection/loaded), routing-lib.mjs + routing-rules.config.json (versioned router), record-load.mjs (PostToolUse Skill) + reload-skills.mjs (SessionStart compact), the settings snippet wiring, edit-gate-records.md, ADR-0098, 11 BDD scenarios + a new step file + the shared-Given refactor in task-receipt.steps.mjs, four discriminating test files, package.json, CHANGELOG. The reviewer confirmed the validator/gate core is sound, the discriminating tests genuinely fail a no-op, name/traversal safety holds, and the #177 step refactor is intact (task-receipt 19/19, BDD 36/36); it raised four findings (2 high, 2 medium), all fixed before this entry.

boundary.evidence: a PreToolUse hook on the file-editing tools only; it delegates to check-task-plan rather than reimplementing validation. F4 fix: Bash is no longer matched (it had denied read-only shell and doubled spawns); Bash writes are backstopped by the #174 finish-check.

ownership.evidence: the selection record and load-state are the single owners of their facts; the gate only reads them.

dependency.evidence: Node built-ins + sibling scripts; the web-concern grep is clean.

error-handling.evidence: F3 fix: the entire end-handler is wrapped in try/catch -> deny, with process uncaughtException and stdin error handlers also routing to deny, so the hook fails CLOSED (exit 2), not open (the default for a crashed PreToolUse hook). Every branch (no selection, selection fail, load fail, ESK_LOADED unset notice) resolves to allow/deny explicitly.

boundary.evidence: F2 fix: wired under SessionStart (matcher compact) in the snippet, so it fires on main-thread compaction (it had been under SubagentStart).

ownership.evidence: writes only the load-state, clearing the selected skills' entries.

error-handling.evidence: F1 fix: it no longer marks skills loaded without delivering their text. A real SKILL.md (20-35 KB) exceeds the 10 KB additionalContext cap, so it CLEARS the selected skills from the load-state and names them to re-load; the edit-gate then holds the next edit until each is genuinely re-read (record-load captures that). Exit 0 always; failure fails safe toward not-loaded. Pinned by a load-state test that asserts the entries are cleared, not added.

boundary.evidence: selection/loaded validators and a versioned path->skills router, each a single-purpose module.

ownership.evidence: the router map has one owner (routing-rules.config.json); check-task-plan derives the skill set from the skills dir.

dependency.evidence: built-ins; check-task-plan imports routing-lib as a sibling.

error-handling.evidence: selection/loaded HOLD (exit 2) on a missing verdict/reason, a router-required self-waive, an unloaded or stale skill, or malformed input; loadRoutingConfig throws on a malformed map and routerRequired catches -> hold; name/traversal (./.., separators) rejected before any join.

boundary.evidence: a PostToolUse hook on Skill that records a genuine load, keyed by the skill file hash.

error-handling.evidence: exit 0 always; an unrecorded load fails safe toward not-loaded (the gates catch it); unknown/unsafe skill names are ignored, never recorded.

boundary.evidence: four discriminating test files (routing-lib per-rule, check-task-plan, edit-gate, load-state); 11 @audience:agent scenarios drive the real scripts on the harness.

ownership.evidence: the shared 'selection marks 6 skills' Given was refactored to be generic, receipt setup moved into #177's following step; #177 behavior preserved (task-receipt 19/19, BDD 36/36).

error-handling.evidence: a no-op gate/validator flips every HOLD; the load-state test now pins the cleared-not-falsely-loaded behavior; snippet parses and is wired SessionStart/SubagentStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse correctly.

findings.finding: it recorded every selected skill as loaded (current hash) and only THEN truncated additionalContext to 10 KB; a real SKILL.md is 20-35 KB, so no body was actually delivered yet all were marked loaded - a false 'loaded' that let the post-compaction edit proceed with the skill text absent, defeating the PR's core promise. Not covered (sandboxes used ~120-byte stub skills).
findings.resolution: fixed: reload-skills now CLEARS the selected skills from the load-state and names them to re-load (no inline bodies, no false loaded); the edit-gate holds until each is genuinely re-read (record-load captures it). The load-state test now asserts the entries are cleared, not added.

findings.finding: the compact reload block was the second element of the SubagentStart array, so it never ran on main-thread compaction (which fires SessionStart source=compact) - the feature did not cover its own motivating case.
findings.resolution: fixed: moved the compact reload block into the SessionStart array with matcher 'compact'.

findings.finding: only JSON.parse was guarded; any throw after it (resolve, existsSync, spawnSync) or a stdin error would exit 1, which Claude Code treats as non-blocking, so the edit would PROCEED with the gate bypassed - contradicting the file's own fail-closed claim.
findings.resolution: fixed: the whole end-handler is wrapped in try/catch -> deny, with process.on(uncaughtException) and stdin 'error' -> deny.

findings.where: settings.snippet.json PreToolUse matcher + edit-gate Bash path
findings.finding: matching all Bash denied read-only commands (ls, git status) before a selection could be written and added 1-2 node spawns per Bash call, pressuring a rubber-stamp selection; the code's own comment names #174 as the Bash backstop anyway.
findings.resolution: fixed: dropped Bash from the PreToolUse matcher and removed the Bash branch from edit-gate; documented that Bash-written files are backstopped by the #174 finish-check.

routing-lib validates rule shape but not that requires[] entries are strings; config is versioned/trusted, left as a low-risk note.
